correctness.rationale: Direct nodal Gram matrix G00=M/3, G0i=m_i/6, Gii=m_i/3 has Schur complement M/4 and invertible diagonal leaf block. Its inverse yields the row kernel at center 4-6s and leaf endpoint (-2+3s) on other edges, [-2+3(1+1/q)s] on its own edge, normalized by total M. Exact absolute affine integration gives center row 5/3 and leaf row (7+3q)/[3(1+q)]; convexity along every edge and differing endpoint signs excludes interior maxima. Strict decrease in q proves minimum-mass leaves, balance minimum, >2 iff q*<1/3, and negativity defect via P1=1. The d=1 two-endpoint special case is proved. Independent Gram inverses and row norms over 180 random positive-mass stars, degrees 1..12, differed by at most 1.34e-15 and recovered all maximizing leaves.
residual_risks: Boundary d=1 is special: center and leaf both norming; data may be discontinuous for sign-input extremizers.
